title: TraceBench: Controlled Evaluation of LLM Agents for Time-Series Root-Cause Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2608.27182v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly applied to anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in time-series observations collected from real-world systems; however, their performance on these tasks has not been systematically evaluated under controlled conditions. We introduce TraceBench, a simulation-based framework for generating controlled root-cause attribution tasks. In each generated task, an agent receives time-series observations produced by simulating a physical dynamical system and must determine whether a system parameter was altered during the simulation and, if so, which one. Using TraceBench, we generate tasks from three interpretable mechanical systems and systematically evaluate four LLM agents across controlled experimental conditions, yielding new insights into how these agents analyze time-series observations from dynamical systems. translated_title: TraceBench：时间序列根因归因的LLM代理受控评估
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理越来越多地被应用于从真实世界系统收集的时间序列观测中的异常检测和根因分析；然而，这些任务在受控条件下的性能尚未得到系统评估。我们引入了TraceBench，一个基于模拟的框架，用于生成受控的根因归因任务。在每个生成的任务中，代理接收由模拟物理动态系统产生的时间序列观测，必须确定模拟过程中系统参数是否被改变，如果是，则确定哪个参数被改变。利用TraceBench，我们从三个可解释的机械系统生成任务，并在受控实验条件下系统评估四个LLM代理，从而对这些代理如何分析来自动态系统的时间序列观测提供新的见解。我们的结果表明，代理从领域上下文中获益显著，并主要探索数据。
tldr: 本文提出TraceBench，一个基于模拟的受控框架，用于系统评估LLM代理在时间序列根因归因任务中的表现，发现领域上下文显著提升代理性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TraceBench, a simulation-based controlled framework for systematically evaluating LLM agents on time-series root-cause attribution tasks, revealing that domain context substantially enhances agent performance.
